notes.title: Hotfix and updates
notes.notes:
Another update for Run Of Mydan!

Here is a list of the major fixes:

- Not yet 100% tested freeze fix
- fixed bloom post-process that had disappeared
- downpowered orbs, which now act more like grenades and explode in proximity if 1 second has passed. Timeout explosion at 2 seconds after throw.
- increased spear throw angular velocity tolerance
- preview update for Pelis: still a prototype but a slightly improved visuals
- leaderboard with player rating based on ratio, number of kills and matches won
- fixed hitboxes which are now 4 boxes attached to the avatar: head, torso, left thigh and right thigh
- arm Ik fix when hands are behind body

notes.title: A known Issue and a little dev update!
notes.notes:
There have been numerous reports regarding technical issues where the game completely freezes. We've found out that it's related to the Unreal Engine 4.17 and we're doing our best in trying to work around this problem.
So along with our apologies we also wanted to communicate that this problem is unfortunately at a lower level and is affecting many games based on Unreal Engine's latest version... If we cannot find a solution we'll fallback on earlier versions.

Besides bad and stressful news, we also wanted to announce that we'll soon be releasing an updated (yet still unfinished) version of Pelis (the prototype map :D). Here are some update pics:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29774715/e876b5a7a61a59d840a7864e87fe5e2e16b32833.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29774715/0920507c7cb00e55634186a28a56a94e3cd5d7b7.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29774715/c9f05386ccd5790b8a25db5bc59efa3b36572a2f.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29774715/cfbfc3217c9345cef3f3d954b687d4f76460331b.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29774715/43f05b25fbf944b4abff4b2e0c998d7c04c81b18.png[/img]

notes.title: Run Of Mydan upgrades to a new engine version!
notes.notes:
It isn't always easy to move all of your work to a newer version of the engine, it takes a lot of time if there were major changes that cause problems between the transition. But when you realize how much a game can gain from such an update you know that your efforts will pay off! 

So we did it! We paused the development for a bit, and made it through various versions of the engine. It wasn't an easy task, but now that we finally made it, we're proud to announce that Run Of Mydan gained a boost in both performance and visuals thanks to Unreal Engine 4.17!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29774715/d09f2a07f0a02585cde7700797e1bf6577ac3b83.png[/img]

'Till next time ;)

notes.title: Run Of Mydan - 0.2.8.1 minor update and hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Just checking in to tell you we updated the game and did some fixes:

- updated Edylins map border ring with entire new model
- made machine gun slightly more precise
- fixed weird head movement bug
- fixed oculus hand offset not replicating correctly across the network
- fixed pause menu realignment issue
- ... a lot of other minor bug fixes

notes.title: Run Of Mydan - hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey there!
Here we are again, with some big fixes. We got reports of clients disconnecting during map transitions, and we hope that this issue is finally dealt with. We wish to apologize for the struggles we had with this, Unreal wasn't very helpful in this particular case! :)

- fixed that map transition thing
- fixed bug when pausing as a spectator
- fixed platform movement since the addition of new flight modes
- fixed machine gun click sound which wasn't spatialized

We are also working on bringing Pelis (the prototype map) to life, so expect an update with new content soon!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29774715/0a1d98cdfdd18e5f0caea86f28b2ff5e8a4ba55f.jpg[/img]
